# Thineth Shehara (Shei) - Complete Developer Specification & Portfolio Content

## Summary & Ethos
Thineth Shehara (known to teammates as Shei) is a Software Engineer based in Tampere, Finland, studying Software Engineering (B.Eng) at Tampere University of Applied Sciences (TAMK). He specializes in mobile application engineering (Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI), real-time backend infrastructure (WebSockets, Python/Flask, Laravel), inventory synchronization pipelines, and web applications.

Teams bring Thineth in when projects are complex, fragile, or requiring cross-domain ownership. He bridges mobile apps, real-time services, cloud architectures, and user interfaces to ship fast, reliable, production-ready software.

- **Real-Time & API Integration**: WebSockets, REST APIs, Stripe Payment Gateways, NFC payment integration, Bol.com marketplace API, WooCommerce REST API, DHL/GLS API pipelines.

## Detailed Project Showcase

### 1. Slate Agentic & Slate Origin (iOS App)
- **Overview**: Intelligent notes application for iPhone built with Swift and SwiftUI.
- **Slate Agentic (v2)**: Rebuilt for autonomous knowledge workflows. Connects SwiftData notes to cloud LLM models (Ollama), features inline Generative UI (GenUI) checksheets & forms, custom GFM Markdown parser, live LaTeX math rendering via MathJax/KaTeX, and pure-Swift ZIP/PDF/DOCX/XLSX text extraction.
- **Slate Origin (v1)**: Local-first native writing environment with SwiftData persistence, Apple VisionKit visual OCR scanning, custom bidirectional Markdown editor, and AI note organizer.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/sheharanayanananda/Slate
